messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a non-incident rollout for regional/edge routing to eu-west and apac-edge in ~30m. Sam will run the deploy. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~20m. TTL change to 60s. Posting quick smoke checklist below, please ack and call dibs on watches. :eyes:

sam: I got this. I'll start the pipeline ~10m before the first shift so we have time for prechecks. I’ll tag the PR and leave rollback notes in the deploy description.

maya: Deploy-bot will kick off the pipeline when Sam starts. Remember: policy fallback exists if we need to revert.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline queued by sam — https://ci.redwood.example/pipelines/4352 (status: queued)

noah: I can flip the Route53 TTL to 60s now so changes propagate faster. ETA 2m. Will comment when done.

ana: (typo) ana: I’ll run smoke tests and watch metrics during each step. Targets: p95 latency < 200ms, 5xx rate < 0.5%, success rate > 99%. I’ll post quick results after each bump.

liam: Backup of current routing policy saved: /infra/routing/backups/routing-eu-apac-2026-03-12.json. If we need to rollback, that file + the rollback command below is the path.

maya: Smoke checklist (copy):
1) curl health endpoint from both regions:
```
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}s' https://eu.example/api/health
```
2) run synthetic scenario (10 req/s for 2m)
3) check p95/p99 and 5xx in APM dashboards
4) trace a request through: sample-id -> check KV cache hits
5) ensure traffic shift metrics show expected %s

maya: Rollback quick command (if needed):
```
# restore previous policy
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-infra/backups/routing-eu-apac-2026-03-12.json /tmp/prev.json
redwoodctl routing apply --file /tmp/prev.json --region eu-west --region apac-edge
```

sam: Starting the pipeline in 8m and will post status updates. If I don’t respond, assume it’s automated and watch the dashboards.

noah: TTL updated to 60s in Route53. Propagation starting now. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started by sam — https://ci.redwood.example/pipelines/4352 (status: running)

sam: Canary at 5% kicked off now. Monitoring.

ana: 5% smoke: health checks OK, no meaningful increase in errors, p95 ~ 180ms. Continuing to monitor for 5m. :thumbsup:

liam: Observability note: If p95 spikes >250ms or 5xx >0.5% for >3m, start rollback procedure.

deploy-bot: Automated canary bump scheduled: 5% -> 25% in 8m (unless canceled).

maya: Quiet window request: try to avoid unrelated infra changes for the next 30m to reduce noise.

liam: I’ll be oncall and watching the routing dashboards for 40m. Ping me in this thread if anything odd.

sam: Will shift to 25% in ~7m then hold for checks. Planning final 100% after another ~12m if all clear.

ana: 25% bump smoke looks good after 3m hold. p95 190ms, 5xx 0.11%. Moving to hold.

sam: Kicking full shift to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Routing policy rollout progression: 25% -> 100% (automated) — details in pipeline run 4352.

maya: Nice — once the rollout completes, please paste final metric snapshots here (APM link + quick numbers). I’ll update the runbook and close the loop.

noah: DNS change fully in effect (TTL 60s).

liam: Final check: no sustained error spikes, latency stable. All good from infra side.

ana: Final metrics: p50 45ms, p95 185ms, 5xx 0.09%, success 99.96%. Looks healthy. :tada:

sam: Rollout complete — recording postmortem notes in the rollout doc. Thanks all.

maya: Thanks team. Filing the short notes to runbook and will follow up with a brief status in #eng-all-hands tomorrow. :slightly_smiling_face:
